memory_candidates.content: In Lean tableau/loop-guard work, a key-enrichment change and the mint-payload change that makes it provable are one atomic landing, not two independent edits. When a key invariant is a subset relation into a LITERAL-BRANCH-MEMBERSHIP predicate (relevantSetFinset here), adding a member to the key silently makes the invariant FALSE rather than harder unless the branch payload emits that member too. Check the invariant codomain semantics before scoping a key change. Corollary on shape: make the payload change ADDITIVE (oldPayload ++ extra) rather than an interleaved rewrite -- every existing membership proof is a List.mem_append_left / List.mem_cons_of_mem chain into the original list and survives with one extra wrapper, whereas a rewrite forces each to be re-derived (measured here at ~20 proof bodies). Corollary on invariants: a new derived property should be threaded as an extra hypothesis, never added as a structure FIELD, when downstream construction sites use positional refine.
